notes: 拉取落地加固：工作区与会话纳入必需同步组（不可误取消）；拉取前检查 scope、本机根路径与 link: 插件前置条件并给出明确诊断；bundle 未解析不再触发回滚、避免擦掉已落地的工作区/会话；落地后校验工作区登记表（workspaceIds、默认工作区、重复路径）与会话目录并写 pull-landing-check.json，让另一台机器拉取即能用。
notesEn: Pull landing hardening: workspace and conversations become required sync groups; preflight checks scope, local roots and link: plugin prerequisites before pull with clear diagnostics; unresolved bundles no longer trigger rollback that wipes landed workspace/session data; post-landing verification checks the workspace registry (workspaceIds, default workspace, duplicate paths) and session directories, writing pull-landing-check.json so a second machine is usable right after pull.
